hints.title: Join and Filter
hints.text: Combine customer accounts with their subscription records on matching customer identifiers.

hints.title: Auto-Renewal Status
hints.text: Isolate subscriptions where auto renewal flag is turned off.

hints.title: Date Window Matching
hints.text: Filter for end dates falling within the target calendar expiration window.

hints.title: Reference Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    c.customer_id,
    c.name,
    s.end_date
FROM Customers c
JOIN Subscriptions s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.auto_renew = 0
  AND s.end_date BETWEEN '2026-11-01' AND '2026-11-30'
ORDER BY c.customer_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Index-assisted date range scan and primary key join.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Full table scans without date predicates scale poorly with large subscription histories.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for matched join output.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use range comparison on dates and equality filter on boolean flags.

import pandas as pd

def find_churn_risk_customers(customers: pd.DataFrame, subscriptions: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    subscriptions['end_date'] = pd.to_datetime(subscriptions['end_date'])
    mask = (subscriptions['auto_renew'] == 0) & (subscriptions['end_date'] >= '2026-11-01') & (subscriptions['end_date'] <= '2026-11-30')
    filtered = subscriptions[mask]
    merged = customers.merge(filtered, on='customer_id')
    merged['end_date'] = merged['end_date'].dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    return merged[['customer_id', 'name', 'end_date']].sort_values('customer_id')
